scope: Bounded real-GPU recorder compatibility and pre/post input-capture validation, separate from formal defense estimates.
source_loading: Verified upstream package files copied into ignored assets/recorder-source and selected with process-local relative PYTHONPATH; installed packages unchanged.
version_interpretation: The recorder module reports source 0.7.0; scientific runner versions and environment package inventory report the actually installed 0.6.1 distribution. These are distinct observations.

input_change_probe.role: Auxiliary declared diagnostic input; the scientific runner does not read it.
input_change_probe.expected: Schema-2 snapshot retains original bytes; post-child check records changed hashes; captured Git dirty state is preserved. Scientific inputs remain unchanged.

acceptance: Actual complete inference coverage, zero child exit and distinct genuine capture IDs.
Source payload hashes verified before and after; original environment and formal freezes unchanged.
Three source schema-2 captures with pre_child/post_child phases and consumption unverified; released reference remains schema 1.
Only the predeclared auxiliary input changes in the diagnostic capture; no changed inputs in ordinary source captures.
Run-ID links, binding agreement, offline full-weight locks, explicit selected exports and actual cross-workspace diff.
Record output/score differences between source D0, diagnostic D0 and released D0 without assuming equality or changing scientific estimates.
gpu_policy: Recheck free memory before every launch; at most one of these four useful conditions per available device, minimum 8192 MiB free; fewer devices run in waves.
limits: No model downloads, training, paid calls, product-source changes or package upgrades.
This is not a new formal model/defense comparison, a release qualification, or five-project product acceptance.
Source GPU interruption, hard-kill and corrupt-output repair are outside this protocol.
